milestones.title: Skeleton (deploy smoke)
milestones.goal: Rust crate compiles; the binary is injected into pmon and stays RUNNING under supervisor. Deploy-smoke gate only: the suite's clean-baseline fixture requires TRANSCEIVER_INFO repopulation, so no pytest passes on a bare skeleton -- the harness special-cases M0 to check supervisor RUNNING. Stand up DaemonXcvrd boot (init/run/deinit), the platform + STATE_DB seams, and the worker-thread scaffold without any table producers yet.

milestones.title: Presence, identity & liveness
milestones.goal: On module discovery/insertion read identity via the platform bridge and publish TRANSCEIVER_INFO (full CMIS dict vs. fixed SFF field list) plus TRANSCEIVER_STATUS_SW.status=1/error=N/A; seed the boot cmis_state=READY projection so downstream DOM can flow; on removal clear TRANSCEIVER_INFO and restore on re-plug. Retry a failed EEPROM identity read (60s cadence) and purge stale TRANSCEIVER_INFO left in STATE_DB at cold-start init. This establishes the INFO/STATUS_SW baseline the whole suite's clean-baseline fixture and liveness guard depend on.

milestones.title: DOM sensors, thresholds & polling
milestones.goal: Run the DomInfoUpdateTask periodic loop: publish TRANSCEIVER_DOM_SENSOR (temperature, voltage and the 24 per-lane tx/rx power + tx bias keys, unit-stripped) with a last_update_time stamp, seed boot TRANSCEIVER_DOM_THRESHOLD, and (fast loop) TRANSCEIVER_DOM_TEMPERATURE. Honor the CONFIG_DB dom_polling=disabled gate. The emulator Monitor trace must show xcvrd genuinely polling the module and reacting to a plug event.

milestones.title: Rich transceiver status
milestones.goal: Publish the rich TRANSCEIVER_STATUS table from the DomInfoUpdateTask read of get_transceiver_status(): module_state, module_fault_cause, DP[1-8]State, config_state_hostlane[1-8], dpinit_pending/dpdeinit, per-lane tx/rx OutputStatus, txNdisable, tx_disabled_channel (admin-down baseline ModuleLowPwr / DataPathDeactivated), each row carrying a well-formed last_update_time.

milestones.title: SFP errors & flag metadata
milestones.goal: Decode injected hardware error bitmaps to descriptions and write TRANSCEIVER_STATUS_SW.error (blocking error removes DOM rows but keeps TRANSCEIVER_INFO; non-blocking keeps DOM; recovery on re-plug clears the error and repopulates DOM). Run the flag-metadata engine for the DOM and STATUS latched-flag tables: TRANSCEIVER_DOM_FLAG / TRANSCEIVER_STATUS_FLAG plus each _CHANGE_COUNT/_SET_TIME/_CLEAR_TIME sibling, bumping the change count on a transition and stamping set/clear times (NEVER init). Re-capture the flag tables off-cadence on a link-change flap.

milestones.title: VDM, PM & firmware diagnostics
milestones.goal: Add the remaining DomInfoUpdateTask diagnostic posters: the VDM freeze->capture->unfreeze sequence populating TRANSCEIVER_VDM_REAL_VALUE (basic + statistic min/max/avg), the four TRANSCEIVER_VDM_{HALARM,LALARM,HWARN,LWARN}_THRESHOLD tables and the per-type VDM flag tables (with flag metadata); TRANSCEIVER_PM for coherent modules (skipped on flat-memory); and TRANSCEIVER_FIRMWARE_INFO (active/inactive firmware).

milestones.title: CMIS datapath bring-up (core)
milestones.goal: Run the CmisManagerTask datapath bring-up state machine (INSERTED -> DP_PRE_INIT_CHECK -> DP_DEINIT -> AP_CONFIGURED -> DP_INIT -> DP_TXON -> READY): drive an admin-up CMIS port out of low power to ModuleReady with every configured datapath DataPathActivated, select the application from the module advertisement by host-lane-count + speed, compute host/media lane masks, publish intermediate cmis_state to TRANSCEIVER_STATUS_SW and active_apsel_hostlaneN to TRANSCEIVER_INFO, and gate DOM publication while a port is still in CMIS init (non-terminal cmis_state).

milestones.title: CMIS bring-up edge cases & fast-reboot
milestones.goal: Handle the CMIS state-machine edges: per-state timers with a retry cap driving cmis_state=FAILED instead of looping forever; datapath teardown + re-provision on reconfiguration; forced Tx-disable when bring-up preconditions are lost (host_tx_ready != true OR admin_status != up); reacting to host_tx_ready transitions; and the fast-reboot datapath-skip that preserves an already-active datapath across re-init.

milestones.title: Module power control & coherent tuning
milestones.goal: Operator-driven module control-plane: sfputil lpmode / reset through XCVRDUtils get_lpmode/set_lpmode/reset with the expected write trace and module-state-machine transitions; gate the VDM-statistic freeze (and thus the TRANSCEIVER_PM refresh) while an activated coherent module is in low-power mode; and the coherent/ZR laser tuning writes configure_tx_output_power / configure_laser_frequency with grid validation.

milestones.title: Media & optics SI settings
milestones.goal: Parse media_settings.json and drive notify_media_setting, managing the STATE_DB PORT_TABLE.NPU_SI_SETTINGS_SYNC_STATUS lifecycle (seed/reset around the notify); and apply per-vendor optics Signal-Integrity settings from optics_si_settings.json during CMIS bring-up.

milestones.title: SFF-8636 / flat-memory path
milestones.goal: Support the non-CMIS module served by the emulator: SFF-8636 identity routing (Sff8636Api), DOM, and the optional SffManagerTask deterministic link bring-up (tx_disable per host_tx_ready/admin_status, lpmode-disable, high-power-class enable); and short-circuit the CMIS state machine straight to READY for flat-memory modules.

milestones.title: Multiport concurrency & table lifecycle
milestones.goal: Prove per-module isolation with all tasks running concurrently across many ports/subports (natsort breakout ordering, no cross-talk on presence/change-events/DOM); and the full table-lifecycle contract: a physical unplug and a CONFIG_DB logical-port PORT_DEL delete the port's rows across the whole TRANSCEIVER_* table set, with a re-add repopulating them and reseeding NPU_SI_SETTINGS_SYNC_STATUS; warm/fast-reboot shutdown preserves TRANSCEIVER_STATUS / TRANSCEIVER_STATUS_SW (a normal shutdown deinit deletes them).

milestones.title: Golden conformance (full suite)
milestones.goal: Reproduce the reference STATE_DB projection exactly (golden per-scenario captures) and pass the ENTIRE xcvrd-tests suite cumulatively, including all slow tests, with no marker filter. This is the terminal full-suite conformance gate for the port.

milestones.title: Retry deferred tests
milestones.goal: Fix and re-enable the previously-skipped e2e tests so they pass: ["test_dom_gating.py::test_dom_gated_during_cmis_init", "test_link_change_flags.py::test_link_change_triggers_fast_flag_recapture", "test_cmis_datapath.py::test_cmis_datapath_activated", "test_cmis_state_progression.py::test_cmis_state_progression"]. Implement the daemon functionality they exercise; they have been re-enabled in the cumulative gate for this milestone. If they still cannot pass, they will be skipped permanently.
